exposure: women who underwent vulvoplasty vs. other women of reproductive age
outcome: serious complications or adverse events after vulvoplasty
cohort: All women who had vulvoplasties in NSW hospitals during 2001-2013, compared with all women of reproductive age
finding: The number of vulvoplasties performed in NSW increased dramatically since 2001, with a serious short-term adverse event rate of 7.2%, and women who had vulvoplasty were more likely to have caesarean deliveries in subsequent births.
